|translation='''Title:''' Snowtrooper.

'''Card text:'''
Deploy only on Hoth. Thereafter, may move anywhere. Power −1 at a location other than a Hoth location.

'''Lore:'''
Cold Assault troopers are trained to operate below freezing and wear special equipment. Blizzard Force’s snowtroopers often fight in coordination with AT-ATs.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese face uses 位置 (location) for the power penalty.
